gold: Primary invasive lobular breast carcinoma in heterotopic cutaneous breast tissue

selector.rationale: Hidradenocarcinoma best explains the histopathological findings of dermal tumor infiltrating subcutaneous fat with 'Indian file pattern' and positive immunohistochemistry for pancytokeratin, cytokeratin 20, and GCDFP15, along with the clinical presentation of a slowly growing subcutaneous node in the axilla.

rejected.label: Sweat gland carcinoma
rejected.why: Less specific than Hidradenocarcinoma given the presence of apocrine gland involvement

rejected.label: Carcinoma of mammary-like gland
rejected.why: Less supported by the evidence, with fewer and less specific findings

rejected.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
rejected.why: While apocrine gland involvement is noted, Hidradenocarcinoma is more comprehensive in explaining the clinical and histopathological findings
